clue.text: Pretty wife wearing shirt

indicators.note: the shirt is worn around the wife, so the wife's letter sits inside it

parts.note: a tee is a T-shirt

explanation.surface: A wife looks pretty in her shirt.
explanation.walkthrough: Twee is chiefly British: overly dainty or sweetly quaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Twee means excessively or affectedly pretty, quaint in a sentimental way.

clue.text: Litigant in court protecting wild animal

indicators.note: the court letters surround and so shelter the shuffled animal
wild suggests the letters of animal running out of control into a new order

explanation.surface: A litigant in a courtroom is defending a wild beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in court' looks like the setting for the litigant, but court here is just its abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A claimant is the party bringing a legal action, a litigant suing in court.

clue.text: Henry's tucking into baby fish

indicators.note: the henry's letter is tucked inside the baby

parts.note: a cub is a baby animal
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance; the 's reads as 'is'

explanation.surface: Henry is eating a little fish meant for the baby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Henry's tucking into' reads as Henry eating, but 's is 'is' and the H is placed inside CUB.
explanation.definitionFit: The chub is a freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: Fight with the heart of Diego Costa to get cut

parts.note: to spar is to fight, as boxers do in practice

indicators.note: the heart is the centre, so take the middle letter of Diego

parts.note: costa is the anatomical Latin word for a rib

explanation.surface: Footballer Diego Costa is picking a fight, his heart set on taking a cut.
explanation.walkthrough: Diego Costa is a combative Spanish footballer; his surname is also the Latin anatomical term for a rib.
explanation.definitionFit: A spare rib is a cut of pork taken from the ribs with most of the meat trimmed off.

clue.text: Cocaine he was moving for nut

parts.note: C is slang shorthand for cocaine

indicators.note: moving shifts these letters around into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone high on cocaine was going for a nut.
explanation.definitionFit: The cashew is a kidney-shaped edible nut from a tropical tree.

clue.text: Winds up Dracula's victim in High Street

indicators.note: the victim's name goes in the middle of the shuffled street
high as in drunk or intoxicated, so the letters of street are scrambled

parts.note: Mina Harker is preyed on by the count in Bram Stoker's Dracula

explanation.surface: Dracula's latest victim winds up on the High Street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High Street' looks like one place name, but 'High' is the scrambling signal, meaning intoxicated. In Britain the high street is a town's main shopping street.
explanation.definitionFit: To wind something up is to bring it to an end, which is what terminates means.

clue.text: General worked in government department

indicators.note: the letters for worked sit within the department's initials

parts.note: FCO is the UK's Foreign and Commonwealth Office
ran, as a machine or business ran

explanation.surface: A general once worked in a ministry.
explanation.walkthrough: The Foreign and Commonwealth Office is the British foreign ministry.
explanation.definitionFit: Francisco Franco was the Spanish general who ruled Spain as dictator from 1939 to 1975.

clue.text: Solicitor let out twisted hooligan

parts.note: to rent out a room is to let it out

indicators.note: twisted turns the hooligan's word round to read backwards

parts.note: yob is British slang for a loutish hooligan

explanation.surface: A lawyer has released a delinquent thug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solicitor' looks like the British lawyer; here it means one who solicits for sex.
explanation.definitionFit: A rent boy is a young male prostitute, someone who solicits clients.

clue.text: Catfish husband to reveal cheat

parts.note: the wels is a huge European catfish

explanation.surface: An online catfish's husband exposes a fraudster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Catfish' suggests online impersonation, but it is the wels, a real fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To welsh is to cheat by failing to pay a debt or keep a promise.

clue.text: World Bank dropping fine for grower in London?

parts.note: a planet is a world

indicators.note: the fine letter is dropped from the bank

parts.note: a reef is a bank of rock or sand near the surface of the sea
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: The World Bank stops imposing a fine on a London business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'World Bank' looks like the financial institution. The London plane is the hybrid tree lining many London streets, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The plane tree grows all over London, where the hardy London plane variety is the city's commonest street tree.

clue.text: Drug behind endless corruption in city

indicators.note: corruption turns the letters bad, rearranging them

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: endless cuts off the last letter of behind

parts.note: taken as written before its last letter goes

explanation.surface: Drug-related corruption without end lies behind life in the city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims BEHIND to BEHIN; 'corruption' then rearranges DRUG plus BEHIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Edinburgh is the capital city of Scotland.

clue.text: Guy Ritchie finally has time for artist

parts.note: a guy is a man

indicators.note: finally picks out the last letter of Ritchie

explanation.surface: Film director Guy Ritchie at last has time for an artist.
explanation.walkthrough: Guy Ritchie is a British film director; 'Guy' is just a man here.
explanation.definitionFit: Edouard Manet was the French painter whose work bridged realism and Impressionism.

clue.text: Europa organisation welcoming Qatar is more shady

indicators.note: the shuffled letters welcome the Qatar letter in among them
organisation arranges the letters of Europa in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
Q is the international vehicle code for Qatar

explanation.surface: A European organisation letting Qatar in looks rather murky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' rearranges EUROPA into OPAUER, and 'welcoming' takes Q inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Opaquer means harder to see through or understand, which is what more shady means.

clue.text: Dog losing lead in skateboard jump

indicators.note: a dog losing its lead also loses its leading letter

parts.note: a collie is a sheepdog breed

explanation.surface: A dog slips its lead mid-leap at the skate park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing lead' looks like a dog off the leash; it drops the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An ollie is the basic skateboarding trick of popping the board into the air without using hands.

clue.text: Solo nude modelled astride car

indicators.note: the shuffled nude letters straddle the car, one part on each side
modelled reshapes the letters of nude

parts.note: taken as written
the Ford Escort is a car

explanation.surface: A nude model poses alone astride a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'modelled' rearranges NUDE into UNED, which goes 'astride' ESCORT.
explanation.definitionFit: Unescorted means unaccompanied, going alone or solo.

clue.text: Left clue for newt?

parts.note: the answer read as wordplay is a clue to newt: the letters of went, with out as a sign to rearrange them

explanation.surface: Someone left after a clue about a newt.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as a cryptic clue: 'out' would tell you to rearrange WENT, giving NEWT.
explanation.definitionFit: Went out is a phrasal verb meaning departed or left.

clue.text: Mark Twain initially into working-out for hobby

indicators.note: the mark and Twain's first letter go into the workout word

parts.note: training is working out, physical exercise
a spot is a mark

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of Twain

explanation.surface: Mark Twain at first takes up exercise for a pastime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark Twain' reads as the author; Mark is a spot and Twain gives only its T.
explanation.definitionFit: Trainspotting is the pastime of logging locomotive numbers, a famously British hobby.

clue.text: Underworld banker announced part of 11 with ecstasy

indicators.note: announced means spoken aloud, giving the sound of the district's name

parts.note: Leith is the port district of Edinburgh, the answer to 11
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: An underworld moneyman announces his piece of the city, plus ecstasy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Underworld banker' sounds like a gangster's money man, but a banker is a river, something with banks. Leith is said 'leeth'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lethe is the river of forgetfulness in the Greek underworld, Hades.

clue.text: See 8
How Galadriel may finish a letter for solver?

parts.note: Yours is the usual sign-off at the end of a letter
Galadriel is an elf in Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings

explanation.surface: How might Tolkien's Galadriel sign off a letter to the person solving?
explanation.walkthrough: Galadriel, being an elf, might sign a letter 'Yours, Elf'.
explanation.definitionFit: Addressed to the solver, the answer names that person: you, the one doing the puzzle.

clue.text: Inventor held back by false teeth

indicators.note: held back says the hidden letters are read backwards
by here means found beside and within the words that follow, which hold the letters

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An inventor is hampered by his dentures.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft had no hiding signal; 'by' marks the letters as sitting within 'false teeth', and 'held back' reads them in reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: Nikola Tesla was the engineer who pioneered alternating-current electrical systems.

clue.text: See 16
Fair Alice upset about return of height

indicators.note: the shuffled Alice goes around the turned letters
upset knocks the letters of Alice into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: return sends the height letters back the other way

explanation.surface: Fair-minded Alice is upset about being sent back for her height.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fair' could be blonde or a funfair, but it means just; 'upset' is the scrambling signal, not Alice's mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethical means morally right, just and fair in conduct.

clue.text: Layer hedging French king's horse

indicators.note: the hen hedges in, or surrounds, the French king

parts.note: a hen is a layer of eggs
roi is French for king; the 's reads as 'is'

explanation.surface: A bricklayer hedges about the French king's horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Layer' suggests a bricklayer; it is a hen, which lays eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: Horse is a slang name for heroin, the opiate drug.

clue.text: Old conservative overcome by passion for six-footer

indicators.note: the old conservative is swallowed up inside the passion

parts.note: lust is strong passion

explanation.surface: An old Tory, overwhelmed by desire, goes for a tall man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'six-footer' suggests a tall person; it is an insect, which has six feet.
explanation.definitionFit: The locust is a swarming grasshopper and, like every insect, has six legs.

clue.text: Shaggy wasted hours getting to grips with new number

indicators.note: the shuffled hours grip the new letter inside them
wasted throws the letters of hours about

parts.note: taken as written
N stands for number, as in maths

explanation.surface: A scruffy type has wasted hours grappling with a new song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shaggy' is the definition, not part of the scene; 'number' is the abbreviation N, not a song.
explanation.definitionFit: Unshorn means uncut, with hair or wool left long and shaggy.

clue.text: Backfiring Cupid's arrow essentially gets more painful

indicators.note: backfiring sends the god's name back the other way

parts.note: Eros is the Greek counterpart of Cupid, god of love

indicators.note: essentially takes the essence, the middle letter, of arrow

explanation.surface: Cupid's arrow misfires and the wound hurts all the more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backfiring' turns EROS into SORE; 'essentially' gives the middle R of ARROW.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorer is the comparative of sore, meaning hurting more or aching worse.

clue.text: Revolutionary characters in crowd upset Duke of York perhaps

indicators.note: revolutionary turns the found letters round the other way
the characters inside these words supply the answer

parts.note: the letters sit across the end of crowd and the start of upset

explanation.surface: Revolutionaries in a crowd upset the Duke of York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duke of York' looks like royalty, but it is a variety of potato.
explanation.definitionFit: Duke of York is an old potato variety, and spud is everyday slang for a potato.

clue.text: Doctors and patients outside Italian restaurant

indicators.note: the patients stand outside, around the restaurant

parts.note: a doctor's cases are patients
trat is short for trattoria, an Italian restaurant

explanation.surface: Doctors and their patients wait outside an Italian restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctors' looks like a noun; it is a verb, as a vet doctors a cat.
explanation.definitionFit: To doctor an animal is to neuter it, so doctors means castrates.

clue.text: President wiping leader's bum

indicators.note: wiping out the leader's first letter removes the opening letter

parts.note: Donald Trump, US president

explanation.surface: A president wipes his leader's backside.
explanation.walkthrough: Bum is British slang for the buttocks.
explanation.definitionFit: The rump is the hindquarters, the backside or bum.

clue.text: Tasteless top from Stone Island designer

indicators.note: the top of Stone is its first letter

parts.note: CK are the initials of fashion designer Calvin Klein

explanation.surface: A tasteless top from the Stone Island fashion label.
explanation.walkthrough: Stone Island is an Italian clothing brand; here it splits into two separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Sick humour is tasteless, making light of death or suffering.

clue.text: Case of vintage urinals vandalised in comprehensive

indicators.note: the vintage case goes in among the wrecked letters
vandalised wrecks the urinals, jumbling their letters

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the case is the outside, the first and last letters of vintage

explanation.surface: A vintage collection of urinals is vandalised in a comprehensive school.
explanation.walkthrough: A comprehensive is a British state school, which the surface leans on; here it is an adjective meaning all-inclusive.
explanation.definitionFit: Universal means all-embracing or covering everything, so it is comprehensive.

clue.text: Maybe Liam Gallagher's touring India and raving

indicators.note: the Manc goes around, touring, the India letter

parts.note: Liam Gallagher of Oasis is a Manc, a person from Manchester; the 's reads as 'is'
I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Liam Gallagher is touring India and going wild.
explanation.walkthrough: Manc is British slang for a Mancunian; Liam Gallagher, Oasis singer, is one.
explanation.definitionFit: Manic describes frenzied, wildly excited behaviour, as raving does.
